radiusSource: Radius 0.964 +/- 0.029 solar radii from Newton et al. 2019, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of DS Tuc A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019ApJ...880L..17N/abstract): 670,655 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.01 +/- 0.06 solar masses from Newton et al. 2019, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of DS Tuc A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019ApJ...880L..17N/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM.
